text:
Nuclear reactions in the Sun release large quantities of energy.
Which statement about this process is correct?
A
It involves the fission of helium to produce hydrogen.
B
It involves the fission of hydrogen to produce helium.
C
It involves the fusion of helium to produce hydrogen.
D
It involves the fusion of hydrogen to produce helium.

options.label: A
options.text: It involves the fission of helium to produce hydrogen.

options.label: B
options.text: It involves the fission of hydrogen to produce helium.

options.label: C
options.text: It involves the fusion of helium to produce hydrogen.

options.label: D
options.text: It involves the fusion of hydrogen to produce helium.
